item.title: Ocean City awaits council vote on Wonderland Pier redevelopment
item.description: There's a proposal for a hotel called "ICONA in Wonderland," which would cost between $135 and $150 million. A zoning change is necessary before any redevelopment can occur, however.

item.title: Camelback Resort leads Pennsylvania ski season with new trails
item.description: Skiers and snowboarders have eagerly awaited the opening day on the slopes, and Camelback Resort in the Poconos has kicked off the season in Pennsylvania.

item.title: RSV, flu, norovirus surge: pediatric cases rise nationwide
item.description: As the colder months settle in, a wave of illnesses like RSV, flu and norovirus are making their presence felt, particularly among young children.

item.title: Delco residents face 19% tax hike in 2026
item.description: Delaware County residents may soon be digging deeper into their pockets again. County officials unveiled a new budget that, if approved, would raise taxes for the third consecutive year.

item.title: Ritz crackers sold in 8 states recalled over undeclared allergen
item.description: A voluntary recall has been issued for Ritz Peanut Butter Cracker Sandwich products in eight states, including Pennsylvania and New Jersey, over a mislabeling problem that may lead to serious allergic reactions. Mondelēz Global LLC recalled 70 cases of the products, with the Food and Drug Administration stating in a Nov. 28 release that this recall is limited to 1 SKU and 2 Code Dates previously recalled in July.
